attributes.name: Rogors Craesby
attributes.powers:
Rogors Craesby is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

Before the encounter, succeed at a Constitution or Fortitude 8 check or the difficulty of all checks is increased by 1 for the rest of the turn.

If undefeated, reset your hand and end your turn.

"Phew! And I thought it stank when the pigs got into the asparagus patch!"—Next-to-last words of Old Crade Hambley
